label: PISA mathematics mean score
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the OECD PISA assessment's own mean mathematics scale scores (the PISA Database, OECD 2023 vintage), 90 entities, the seven triennial cycles 2003-2022, reached through OWID's chart door with the mathematics column pinned (the CSV's own header) — the OECD runs the assessment and prints the scale scores itself (the collector judgment); the SDMX registry carries no PISA dataflow, so the chart door is the machine face. No witness tier — the by-sex door is the same root, the composite learning scores are derived, and TIMSS (the assessment Todd's own table read) has no machine door. Authenticity first per ADR-0008: the assessment's own scores displayed as what they are.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OWID chart door = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: OECD, PISA Database — the OECD's own reuse terms apply upstream).
notes: THE TODD ARC PRINTS ITSELF (todd_refs: 3 citations, all L'illusion économique 1998): the book's educational-decline argument read the OECD's own TIMSS table — the wired door prints the OECD's modern face of the same argument. FRANCE 510.8 (2003) -> 473.9 (2022), the French slide the book's own arc opened (the 2022 cycle is the post-Covid dip, printed); UNITED STATES 482.9 -> 464.9, the American mid-band drift the book set against its university exceptionalism; GERMANY 503 -> 474.8 (2022), JAPAN 534.1 -> 535.6 the stable East-Asian top the declinist tables leaned on, UNITED KINGDOM 508.3 -> 489.0. RUSSIA prints six cycles 2003-2018 (468.4 -> 487.8) and is ABSENT from 2022 — the assessment cycle Russia did not sit, the honest coverage gap (an explicit gap year, never a skip). THE HONEST LIMITS: the assessment seam (TIMSS 8th-grade vs PISA 15-year-olds — two frames, one metric family, documented in sources); the 2000 cycle prints no mathematics mean on this door (the chart carries reading-only rows for 2000 — the PISA 2000 design made reading the major domain; those entities arrive as explicit gap points, the door's own shape); the sub-national participants (Hong Kong, Macao, Taipei, Quebec...) ride the door's own entity list and resolve where the registry carries them; the by-sex faces (Girls/Boys) and the reading/science columns are registered future doors on the same chart; the pre-2003 history is BOOK data — territory curated.
